name: Degen Zoo
classificationNote: Classified by keyword rules from the SlowMist label and description.
rootCause: According to a Telegram announcement, the DAO Maker project Degen Zoo is suspected to have been hacked on Binance Oracle. At present, the project team has suspended the game and launched an investigation. No loopholes have been found yet, and better animals cannot be hatched through smart contract errors.
